title: API Foundations
description: A hands-on beginner JavaScript course covering values, decisions, collections, functions, the DOM, events, JSON, promises, async-await, local fetch, and resilient interface states.
audience: absolute beginners who know basic HTML
students continuing through the web development catalog
learners preparing for frontend application development
goals: Use JavaScript values, variables, expressions, and control flow confidently
Organize repeated work with arrays, loops, objects, and functions
Respond to browser events and update page content through the DOM
Parse JSON and work with promises, async-await, and local fetch
Represent loading, error, empty, and success states clearly
Build a complete Campus Event Explorer in the browser workspace

notes: Use fixedLanguage web and recipeType source_checks for browser JavaScript code_input exercises.
Use script.js with small provided HTML fixtures so learners can focus on JavaScript behavior.
Use local JSON files for fetch instruction; external network access is unavailable.
Teach JSON, promises and async-await, local fetch, and loading, error, and empty states in Module 3 before the capstone.
Do not require frameworks, bundlers, npm, a terminal, or backend services.
Module, section, and topic counts are specific to this course design and are not global curriculum cardinality rules.
